row.evidence: Carta says SSO for company admins is available to all cap table customers on its Scale plan, and its corporate SSO setup requires a Directory Sync step that uses SCIM 2.0 to grant or revoke access.
row.notes: Carta's pricing page (carta.com/pricing now redirects to /plans/equity-management/) shows no prices: Launch is free (up to 25 stakeholders and $1M raised), Build, Grow and Scale are priced per stakeholder with a minimum annual fee via sales; 'SSO for admins' is listed only under Scale. The June row's Launch '$280/yr' and the '~$67k-112k/yr' Scale figure have no first-party source and were dropped; Launch is now free. SCIM ('Directory Sync') is a mandatory step of the corporate SSO setup, which Carta describes as early access rolling out to a limited number of companies, and it covers company admin users only (equity holders cannot use SSO). SCIM groups do not map to Carta roles. The Okta OIN app is SWA-only (only SWA is checked in the page markup), so the June note 'SCIM only via Okta connector' is not supported by Okta's page; Carta's setup is a configuration link sent to IT, and no SCIM base URL is published. Carta's separate Deal CRM product (for investment firms) has a user API (crm-public-api.app.carta.com); the cap-table API has no user-management endpoints.

limitations.text: Corporate SSO (and its SCIM Directory Sync step) is in early access, rolled out to a limited number of companies.
SSO and Directory Sync cover company admin users only; equity holders keep email/password plus 2FA.
Domain verification by DNS TXT record is mandatory before SSO setup completes.
SCIM groups are not mapped to Carta roles.

endpoints.purpose: Get the user associated with the access token (no list/create/deactivate endpoints for cap-table users)

limitations.text: The cap-table (Issuer/Investor) API exposes only the current user; Carta's separate Deal CRM API (https://crm-public-api.app.carta.com) has GET/POST /v1/organization/users and POST /v1/organization/users/:userId/status (ACTIVE or BLOCKED) for CRM users, a different product.

user_api.notes: No user-management API for the equity management product is documented; available left null rather than false because Carta does not say so.

okta.notes: Only SWA is checked in the OIN page markup (last updated Apr. 14 2022); SAML, SCIM and provisioning capabilities are unchecked.
